_metadata.description: Disclosure derivation, the asset-studio handoff for model-backed work, and the reference surface consuming scenarios read.

requirements.title: The system shall derive the AI-generated flag from the declared strategy
requirements.description: The system shall set an asset's AI-generated flag from its style's declared strategy: true for `guided` and `synthesized`, false for `procedural` and `procedural-treated`. The system shall reject any request that sets the flag directly. Marking procedurally drawn output as AI-generated is a false claim, so over-disclosure is refused on the same footing as under-disclosure.

validation.notes: One case per strategy asserting the derived value, plus a case asserting a direct set is rejected.

requirements.title: The system shall release model-backed candidates through asset-studio
requirements.description: While a candidate was produced by a strategy that invoked a model, the system shall release it through `asset-studio` so that provenance, cost, and disclosure are recorded once. The system shall not persist a second provenance record for that asset.

validation.notes: Release a guided candidate through a faked asset-studio seam; assert the handoff carries strategy-derived disclosure and that no local provenance row is written.

requirements.title: The system shall release procedural candidates without an asset-studio handoff
requirements.description: While a candidate was produced without any model invocation, the system shall release it locally and shall not require `asset-studio`. A procedural render incurs no spend, carries no disclosure obligation, and reproduces from its seed, so routing it through a cost-and-disclosure ledger would add a dependency that buys nothing. This keeps the product usable when `asset-studio` is unavailable.

validation.notes: With the asset-studio seam faked to fail on any call, assert a procedural candidate still releases and a guided candidate is refused with a clear cause.

requirements.title: The system shall expose released backdrops by stable identifier without serving their bytes
requirements.description: The system shall expose a released backdrop by stable identifier carrying its placement, reserved regions, measured contrast, disclosure state, and alt text. The consumer reference response shall not contain image bytes, so that a consuming scenario references a backdrop rather than copying it.

validation.notes: Assert the reference response schema carries no byte-bearing field and that every declared metadata field is populated for a released backdrop.

requirements.title: The system shall require operator-authored alt text before release
requirements.description: The system shall refuse to release a backdrop carrying empty alt text. Because an ambient image is decorative in most placements, the system shall accept an explicit decorative marking as a valid answer, but shall require that the choice be made rather than defaulted.

validation.notes: Assert release is refused on empty alt text and permitted when marked decorative.

requirements.title: The system should derive sized variants preserving the reserved regions
requirements.description: The system should derive variants of a released backdrop for the surfaces a page needs — hero, split panel, open-graph card, and mobile crop — and should recompute the reserved regions and its contrast verdict for each variant rather than inheriting the parent's.

validation.notes: Derive each variant; assert an independent region and verdict per variant, and that a variant failing the gate is marked unreleasable.
